title: CONTRA: Discovering and Qualifying Behavior-Changing Questions for Selective Clarification in LLM Code Generation
title_zh: CONTRA: 发现和资格认定行为改变问题以选择性澄清在LLM代码生成中的应用

paragraphs.en: Coding agents can generate code that appears correct but implements behavior the user never intended. This mismatch can arise when an agent silently resolves underspecified requirements through its own assumptions. As subsequent development builds on these assumptions, correcting the resulting behavior can become increasingly costly. Early clarification can help prevent such mismatches, but unnecessary questions can interrupt developers and slow down development. Existing methods struggle to identify key clarification questions while avoiding unnecessary ones. Therefore, we propose Contra , a training-free method that combines broad question discovery with semantic and execution-based question qualification. Contra first generates candidate questions and filters out those unrelated to required behavior or already resolved by the requirement. For each remaining question, it generates programs conditioned on two plausible answers and checks for stable behavioral differences on shared inputs. It then uses the interaction history to select among qualified questions or stop asking. Experiments on ClarifyCodeBench show that Contra achieves the highest F1 with all four coding agents, exceeding the best baseline macro-average F1 by 13.88 percentage points. With the same LLM and evaluation protocol, Contra also achieves higher clarification recall and F1 than the coding harnesses Claude Code and OpenHands. To support practical use, we also implement Contra as a Claude Code plugin that integrates selective clarification into everyday development. 1 1 1 Released method components and plugin: https://github.com/fangz-cs/Contra .

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are increasingly used to generate and modify code from natural-language requirements ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . However, these requirements often leave important aspects of program behavior underspecified, such as how to handle edge cases or format outputs ( Fakhoury et al., 2024 ; Mu et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . Faced with such requirements, an agent may silently adopt one plausible interpretation and proceed with implementation. The resulting code may be correct under that interpretation, yet fail to match the user’s intended behavior ( Fakhoury et al., 2024 ; Vijayvargiya et al., 2026b ; Edwards & Schuster, 2026 ) . If this mismatch goes unnoticed, subsequent development may build on the same assumptions, making correction increasingly costly. Therefore, clarification helps make these assumptions explicit and resolve the underlying choices with the user before the code becomes the basis for further development.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体正被越来越多地用于根据自然语言需求生成和修改代码（Hong 等，2024；Wang 等，2025；Yang 等，2024）。 然而，这些需求常常对程序行为的某些重要方面描述不足，例如如何处理边界情况或如何格式化输出（Fakhoury 等，2024；Mu 等，2024；Fang 等，2026）。 面对此类需求，智能体可能会悄无声息地采用一种看似合理的解释，并据此开始实现。 由此生成的代码在该解释下可能是正确的，但却可能无法符合用户的预期行为（Fakhoury 等，2024；Vijayvargiya 等，2026b；Edwards & Schuster，2026）。 如果这种不匹配未被察觉，后续的开发可能会基于相同的假设继续推进，从而使修正的成本越来越高。 因此，澄清需求有助于明确这些假设，并在代码成为进一步开发的基础之前，与用户共同解决其中涉及的关键选择。

paragraphs.en: However, excessive questioning can impose unnecessary interaction costs on developers ( Zhang & Choi, 2025 ; Vijayvargiya et al., 2026a ) . For example, an agent may ask questions already answered by the requirements or earlier interactions, or raise questions unrelated to the task. This motivates selective clarification, where an agent seeks additional user input only when needed ( Kuhn et al., 2022 ) . For coding agents, this requires identifying necessary questions within a task while avoiding redundant or irrelevant ones.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，过度提问可能会给开发者带来不必要的交互成本（Zhang & Choi, 2025；Vijayvargiya 等, 2026a）。 例如，一个智能体可能会提出需求或先前交互中已经回答过的问题，或者提出与任务无关的问题。 这促使了选择性澄清策略的采用，即智能体仅在必要时才寻求用户的额外输入（Kuhn 等, 2022）。 对于编码智能体而言，这需要在任务中识别必要的问题，同时避免提出冗余或无关的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our results in Table 1 illustrate this trade-off. Direct Prompting ( Vijayvargiya et al., 2026b ; Fang et al., 2026 ) and Ask-or-Assume ( Edwards & Schuster, 2026 ) rely on the model to decide whether to ask, but often miss necessary questions. By comparison, ClarifyGPT ( Mu et al., 2024 ) generates questions from behavioral disagreement among sampled programs, but asks many unnecessary questions. Such disagreement can reflect implementation errors even when the requirements are clear. Therefore, selective clarification requires both broad question discovery and careful qualification.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 中的结果说明了这种权衡。 直接提示（Vijayvargiya 等人，2026b；Fang 等人，2026）和“询问或假设”（Edwards & Schuster，2026）方法依赖模型自行决定是否需要提问，但常常遗漏必要的问题。 相比之下，ClarifyGPT（Mu 等人，2024）通过采样程序之间的行为差异生成问题，但会提出许多不必要的问题。 即使需求明确，这种不一致也可能反映出实现错误。 因此，选择性澄清既需要广泛发现问题，也需要谨慎界定细节。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose Contra , which combines broad question discovery with careful qualification. It first discovers candidate questions and checks whether each is relevant to the requirement and remains unresolved. For each remaining question, Contra generates programs conditioned on two plausible answers and checks for stable behavioral differences on shared inputs. During interaction, it uses the user’s answers to select the next qualified question or stop asking. This design identifies key clarification questions while filtering out unnecessary ones.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Contra，它将广泛的提问探索与严谨的资格验证相结合。 它首先发现候选问题，并检查每个问题是否与需求相关且尚未得到解决。 对于每个剩余问题，Contra 会根据两个合理的答案生成程序，并检查在共享输入上是否存在稳定的行为差异。 在交互过程中，它会利用用户的回答来选择下一个合格的问题，或停止提问。 这种设计能够识别关键的澄清问题，同时过滤掉不必要的问题。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Contra on ClarifyCodeBench ( Fang et al., 2026 ) with coding agents built on GPT-5-mini ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Grok 4.5 ( SpaceXAI, 2026 ) , and Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . Under the same five-question budget, we compare Contra with Direct Prompting, Ask-or-Assume ( Edwards & Schuster, 2026 ) , and ClarifyGPT ( Mu et al., 2024 ) . Contra achieves the highest F1 and turn-discounted key question rate (TKQR) for all four agents. Its macro-average F1 and TKQR reach 41.20% and 38.32%, exceeding the best baseline for each metric by 13.88 and 12.33 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, using Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and the same evaluation protocol, Contra achieves higher recall and F1 than Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) and OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Its F1 reaches 19.86%, compared with 9.63% for Claude Code and 10.61% for OpenHands. Finally, we integrate Contra into Claude Code as a plugin that identifies and reports implementation decisions requiring user clarification.

paragraphs.en: We implement Contra as a Claude Code plugin that identifies and reports implementation decisions requiring clarification, helping developers confirm intended program behavior during everyday development.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Contra 实现为一个 Claude Code 插件，用于识别并报告需要澄清的实现决策，帮助开发者在日常开发过程中确认程序的预期行为。

paragraphs.en: Prior work improves LLM code generation by making user intent more explicit. CodeClarQA ( Li et al., 2023 ) provides questions and answers that enrich underspecified requirements for code generation. TiCoder ( Fakhoury et al., 2024 ) elicits user feedback on generated tests and uses that feedback to formalize intent and rank candidate programs. ClarifyCoder ( Wu et al., 2025 ) uses synthetic data and instruction tuning to teach code LLMs to recognize underspecification and request clarification. Other methods refine specifications without user interaction. SpecFix ( Jia et al., 2025 ) analyzes the behavioral distribution of sampled programs and maps changes in that distribution back to a repaired problem description. Specine ( Tian & Chen, 2026 ) identifies mismatches between an input specification and the specification inferred from generated code, then constructs an aligned specification for subsequent generation. While these methods refine requirements, Contra qualifies individual questions by checking relevance, whether they remain unresolved, and whether plausible answers change program behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作通过使用户意图更明确来改进 LLM 的代码生成。 CodeClarQA（Li 等人，2023）提供了问题和答案，从而丰富代码生成中未充分说明的需求。 TiCoder（Fakhoury 等人，2024）会收集用户对生成测试的反馈，并利用这些反馈来明确意图并对候选程序进行排序。 ClarifyCoder（Wu 等人，2025）使用合成数据和指令微调来训练代码 LLM，使其能够识别未充分说明的情况并请求澄清。 其他方法则无需用户交互即可优化规格说明。 SpecFix（Jia 等人，2025）分析采样程序的行为分布，并将该分布的变化映射回修复后的问题描述。 Specine（Tian & Chen，2026）识别输入规格与从生成代码中推断出的规格之间的不匹配，然后构建一个对齐的规格用于后续生成。 尽管这些方法能够优化需求，但 Contra 会通过检查相关性、问题是否仍未解决以及合理答案是否会改变程序行为来对单个问题进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Selective clarification concerns deciding when additional user input is necessary. CLAM ( Kuhn et al., 2022 ) studies whether an LLM should answer directly or request clarification, while IntentSim ( Zhang & Choi, 2025 ) estimates clarification utility from uncertainty over simulated user intents. Learning-based approaches use simulated future turns to label preferences ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , or train clarification policies using task relevance and user answerability ( Vijayvargiya et al., 2026a ) . In code generation, ClarifyGPT ( Mu et al., 2024 ) uses behavioral disagreement among programs sampled from the same requirement to decide whether to clarify. Ask-or-Assume ( Edwards & Schuster, 2026 ) uses the coding agent or a separate intent agent to decide when user input is needed. Contra evaluates each candidate question through semantic checks and behavioral verification, then uses the interaction history to select qualified questions that still require user input.

paragraphs.en: To expand the candidate set, each discovery round combines context-aware and independent generation. Context-aware generation uses S S and the current candidate set to search for additional questions, while independent generation uses only S S . paragraphs.en: This comparison tests the consequences of alternative answers to a specific question. Shared inputs make the two groups directly comparable, while agreement within each group reduces the influence of an isolated implementation error. A question is retained only when execution provides evidence of a behavioral difference. A failed check does not establish behavioral equivalence.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on ClarifyCodeBench ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , which provides underspecified programming requirements with gold clarification questions and answers. Our evaluation uses 419 underspecified tasks and the 80 fully specified tasks provided by ClarifyCodeBench. Each method may ask at most five clarification questions before generating a final program. The benchmark’s GPT-4o evaluator matches questions against each task’s gold questions by majority vote over three judgments.

paragraphs.en: We compare Contra with three training-free baselines. Direct Prompting uses the benchmark prompt to ask a question or generate code. Ask-or-Assume ( Edwards & Schuster, 2026 ) adds an intent agent that reviews the proposed action and requests clarification when needed. ClarifyGPT ( Mu et al., 2024 ) generates questions from behavioral disagreement among programs sampled from the current requirement and executed on shared inputs. We also compare with the coding harnesses Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) and OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Contra 与三种无需训练的基线方法进行比较。 直接提示法使用基准提示来提出问题或生成代码。 Ask-or-Assume（Edwards & Schuster, 2026）增加了一个意图智能体，用于审查所提议的操作，并在必要时请求澄清。 ClarifyGPT（Mu et al., 2024）根据从当前要求中采样并在共享输入上执行的程序之间的行为差异生成问题。 我们还与编码工具 Claude Code（Anthropic, 2025）和 OpenHands（Wang et al., 2025）进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: We report question precision, recall, F1, and turn-discounted key question rate (TKQR) ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Precision is the proportion of all questions asked that match a previously uncovered gold question, including questions asked on fully specified tasks in the denominator. Recall is the proportion of gold questions matched by at least one question, and F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall. TKQR rewards earlier identification of gold questions using normalized discounted cumulative gain ( Järvelin & Kekäläinen, 2002 ) , averaged across tasks. For the harness comparison, we also report the false-positive rate (FPR): the proportion of fully specified tasks on which at least one question is asked.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了问题精确率、召回率、F1 以及经过轮次折扣的关键问题比率（TKQR）（Fang 等人，2026）。 精确率是指所有已提出问题的比例中，与先前未揭示的黄金问题匹配的问题所占的比例，分母包括在完全指定的任务中提出的问题。 召回率是指至少有一个问题与黄金问题匹配的黄金问题的比例，而 F1 是精确率和召回率的调和平均值。 TKQR 通过归一化折扣累积增益（Järvelin & Kekäläinen，2002）来奖励更早识别出黄金问题的情况，并在各任务中取平均值。 在 harness 比较中，我们还报告了假阳性率（FPR）：即至少有一个问题被提出的完全指定任务所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate coding agents built on GPT-5-mini, GPT-5.5, Grok 4.5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. For each comparison, all components of Contra and the baselines use the same LLM. We use low reasoning effort, with stochastic sampling only for program generation in Behavioral Verification and ClarifyGPT. The harness comparison uses Qwen3.8-27B for Contra , Claude Code, and OpenHands, with the same question budget and scoring procedure. We execute generated Python programs in isolated environments under fixed time, memory, and output limits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了基于 GPT-5-mini、GPT-5.5、Grok 4.5 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 构建的代码编写智能体。 在每次比较中，Contra 和所有基线模型的所有组件均使用相同的 LLM。 我们采用低推理努力模式，仅在行为验证和 ClarifyGPT 的程序生成环节进行随机采样。 在工具对比实验中，Contra、Claude Code 和 OpenHands 均使用 Qwen3.8-27B，且问题预算和评分流程保持一致。 我们在受时间、内存和输出限制约束的隔离环境中执行生成的 Python 程序。

paragraphs.en: Contra achieves the highest F1 and TKQR for every coding agent (Table 1 ). Its macro-average F1 and TKQR reach 41.20% and 38.32%, exceeding the best baselines by 13.88 and 12.33 percentage points, respectively. Table 2 further shows that Contra achieves the highest macro-average precision and recall. These gains reflect more key questions identified and a lower proportion of unnecessary questions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个编码智能体，Contra 都实现了最高的 F1 和 TKQR（表 1）。 其宏观平均 F1 和 TKQR 分别达到 41.20% 和 38.32%，比最佳基线模型分别高出 13.88 和 12.33 个百分点。 表 2 进一步显示，Contra 实现了最高的宏观平均精确率和召回率。 这些提升反映了更多被识别出的关键问题，以及更低的非必要问题比例。

paragraphs.en: The baseline results illustrate the difficulty of identifying key questions while avoiding unnecessary ones. With GPT-5.5, Direct Prompting achieves 59.32% precision but only 15.12% recall, leaving many key questions unasked. Contra increases recall to 36.72% while maintaining 50.15% precision. Conversely, with GPT-5-mini, ClarifyGPT achieves 37.37% recall but only 13.58% precision, indicating that many questions do not identify a previously uncovered gold question. Here, Contra raises precision to 36.20% while retaining a comparable recall of 34.56%. Despite slightly lower recall, Contra improves TKQR from 30.94% to 34.32%, indicating that it finds key questions earlier and uses clarification turns more efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 基线结果表明，在避免提出不必要问题的同时识别关键问题存在困难。 使用 GPT-5.5 时，直接提示法的精确率为 59.32%，但召回率仅为 15.12%，导致许多关键问题未被提出。 Contra 将召回率提升至 36.72%，同时保持了 50.15% 的精确率。 相比之下，使用 GPT-5-mini 时，ClarifyGPT 实现了 37.37% 的召回率，但精确率仅为 13.58%，表明许多问题未能识别出此前未被发现的黄金问题。 在此情况下，Contra 将精确率提升至 36.20%，同时保持了 34.56% 的可比召回率。 尽管召回率略低，Contra 仍使 TKQR 从 30.94% 提升至 34.32%，表明它能更早地找到关键问题，并更高效地利用澄清轮次。

paragraphs.en: Question Discovery achieves high recall across all four coding agents, recovering most gold clarification questions within approximately four discovery rounds. Figure 2 shows how recall and precision change as candidate questions accumulate. Recall rises rapidly in early rounds before saturating, indicating that iterative discovery finds key questions missed initially.

paragraphs.zh: 自适应问题选择利用交互历史，避免提出那些用户先前回答已经解决或使问题不再必要的合格问题。

paragraphs.en: To reduce the cost of Question Qualification, we introduce Contra -Flash, which qualifies candidates on demand. Adaptive Question Selection first chooses a candidate from the discovered questions. The candidate then undergoes Relevance, Resolution, and Behavioral Verification before it can be asked. Rejected candidates are discarded and selection continues. This ordering avoids qualifying candidates that the selector never considers.
paragraphs.zh: 为了降低问题资格认证的开销，我们引入了 Contra-Flash，它可以根据需求对候选者进行资格认证。 自适应问题选择机制首先会从已发现的问题中挑选一个候选者。 随后，该候选者会经过相关性、解决性和行为验证，之后才能被提出。 被拒绝的候选者将被舍弃，选择过程将继续进行。 这种顺序可以避免对选择器从未考虑过的候选者进行资格认证。

sents.zh: 为了降低问题资格认证的开销，我们引入了 Contra-Flash，它可以根据需求对候选者进行资格认证。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows that Contra -Flash reduces candidate-level qualification evaluations by 65.7–96.0%. F1 remains stable for three of the four coding agents: GPT-5-mini, Grok 4.5, and GPT-5.5 reduce qualification evaluations by 85.6%, 83.3%, and 96.0%, respectively, while F1 changes by at most 1.8 percentage points. Flash exceeds the best baseline F1 for all three agents and the best baseline TKQR for Grok 4.5 and GPT-5.5. For Gemini 3.1 Pro, Flash achieves 35.7% F1 and 28.3% TKQR with 65.7% fewer qualification evaluations, placing its F1 within 1.9 percentage points of the best baseline. Overall, Flash offers substantial computational savings with stable F1 on most evaluated agents.

paragraphs.en: We implement Contra as a Claude Code plugin that reviews decisions after implementation. The plugin combines the agent’s own report with an independent review of the requirement and code changes to discover unresolved decisions. It then prioritizes these decisions and explains what the requirement leaves unspecified, what the agent implemented, and a plausible alternative. For unresolved implementation choices, Behavioral Verification runs in the background and uses distinguishing tests to check whether alternative implementations produce different observable behaviors. Plugin implementation details appear in Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Contra 实现为一个 Claude Code 插件，用于在实施后审查决策。 该插件将智能体自身的报告与对需求及代码变更的独立审查相结合，以发现未解决的决策。 接着，它会优先处理这些决策，并说明需求中哪些内容未明确指定、智能体实施了什么，以及一种合理的替代方案。 对于未解决的实施选择，行为验证会在后台运行，并使用区分性测试来检查替代实施是否会产生产生不同可观察行为的结果。 插件的实现细节见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: We presented Contra , a training-free method for selective clarification in coding agents. It combines Question Discovery, Question Qualification, and Adaptive Question Selection. Semantic checks and execution evidence identify consequential choices, while interaction history guides which questions still require user input. Experiments show consistent improvements in F1 and TKQR across four coding agents and gains over existing coding harnesses. Contra -Flash reduces qualification evaluations, while the Claude Code plugin makes unresolved implementation choices and their alternatives explicit for developer review. Future work will evaluate how selective clarification affects developer effort and code quality over longer development sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Contra，一种无需训练的选择性澄清方法，适用于编码智能体。 它结合了问题发现、问题资格认证和自适应问题选择。 语义检查和执行证据能够识别关键决策，而交互历史则指导哪些问题仍需用户输入。 实验表明，在四种编码智能体中，F1 和 TKQR 指标均得到一致提升，且优于现有的编码工具集。 Contra -Flash 减少了资格认证评估次数，而 Claude Code 插件则让未解决的实现决策及其替代方案对开发者清晰可见，便于审查。 未来工作将评估选择性澄清在更长期的开发过程中对开发者投入和代码质量的影响。

paragraphs.en: The Claude Code plugin reviews implementation decisions at the end of an interaction. A hook records the working tree when the user submits a request. When the agent finishes, another hook compares the updated tree with this snapshot to identify changes made during the interaction. This avoids including unrelated changes that were already present before the request.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 插件会在交互结束时审查实现决策。 一个钩子会在用户提交请求时记录工作树。 当智能体完成操作后，另一个钩子会将更新后的树与此快照进行比较，以识别交互期间所做的更改。 这样可以避免包含在请求之前就已经存在的无关更改。

paragraphs.en: The plugin then runs two processes in parallel. One extracts decisions from the agent’s final report using claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 . The other independently reviews the requirement, code changes, and repository context using claude-opus-5 , without reading that report. Their outputs are merged using text overlap for entries concerning the same file and decision category. The combined report distinguishes implementation choices, changes beyond the requested scope, and work the agent decided not to perform. Rule-based prioritization uses these categories together with affected scope, trigger conditions, reversibility, and verification outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 该插件随后并行运行两个进程。 其中一个进程使用 claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 从智能体的最终报告中提取决策。 另一个进程则独立审查需求、代码变更和仓库上下文，使用 claude-opus-5，且不阅读该报告。 对于涉及相同文件和决策类别的条目，通过文本重叠合并两者的输出结果。 合并后的报告会区分实现选择、超出请求范围的变更，以及智能体决定不执行的工作。 基于规则的优先级排序会结合这些类别，同时考虑受影响的范围、触发条件、可逆性以及验证结果。

paragraphs.en: For an unresolved implementation choice, the plugin uses claude-opus-5 to generate a distinguishing test and a patch implementing an alternative interpretation. It executes the test on the current and patched implementations in isolated repository copies. A test that passes on the current implementation and fails on an executable alternative provides evidence of a behavioral difference. Patch or test-execution errors are distinguished from such evidence. In normal use, verification runs in the background after the initial report. Distinguishing tests can be retained in the repository to document the implemented behavior, and a persistent record tracks decisions across interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于未解决的实现选择，该插件使用 claude-opus-5 生成一个区分性测试和一个实现替代解释的补丁。 它在隔离的仓库副本中对当前实现和经过打补丁的实现执行该测试。 一个在当前实现中通过但在可执行的替代实现中失败的测试，为行为差异提供了证据。 补丁或测试执行错误与这类证据区分开来。 在正常使用中，验证在初始报告之后于后台运行。 区分性测试可以保留在仓库中以记录已实现的行为，而持久化记录则追踪跨交互的决策。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation uses 40 single-function commits from six Python repositories, namely Rich, Flask, Requests, Click, HTTPX, and Typer. The tasks are selected by stratified random sampling, with 20 labeled underspecified and 20 labeled fully specified, using seed 20260903. For each task, the repository is restored to its pre-commit state, and the commit message serves as the requirement. Claude Code is asked to modify the target function and briefly explain the change. The final plugin runs use Claude Code 2.1.261 with claude-opus-5 and the research version of the plugin evaluated on September 5, 2026. Each task has one baseline run and one plugin run. Verification runs synchronously during evaluation so that its outcomes are collected before the process exits.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估使用了来自六个 Python 仓库的 40 个单功能提交，这些仓库分别是 Rich、Flask、Requests、Click、HTTPX 和 Typer。 任务通过分层随机抽样进行选择，其中 20 个为带标签的欠指定任务，20 个为带标签的全指定任务，并使用种子值 20260903。 对于每个任务，仓库会被恢复到提交前的状态，而提交信息则作为需求说明。 Claude Code 被要求修改目标函数，并简要解释所做的更改。 最终的插件运行使用了 Claude Code 2.1.261、claude-opus-5 以及于 2026 年 9 月 5 日评估的插件研究版本。 每个任务都包含一次基线运行和一次插件运行。 验证运行在评估期间同步执行，因此其结果会在进程退出前被收集。

paragraphs.en: Report quality is evaluated from the agent’s final reply. We use claude-opus-5 to extract decision entries and check whether each states the unspecified information, the implemented choice, and a plausible alternative interpretation. paragraphs.en: The decision-discovery analysis uses the plugin’s combined structured output, a separate collection from the final-reply entries above. Among its 262 decisions, 116 appear only in independent review, 89 only in the agent-derived list, and 57 in both. The repository evaluation thus measures decision discovery and report completeness.

paragraphs.en: This single-run demonstration reports 40 s ($0.47) for coding, 90 s ($0.17) for reporting, and 15 s ($0.06) for background verification. The report appears about 130 s after the request; the total reported cost, including verification, is $0.70. In this build, executable evidence uses Python and pytest ; other supported source languages receive decision reports. Verification supports the behavior exercised by each distinguishing test.
paragraphs.zh: 此次单次运行演示显示，编码耗时 40 秒（$0.47），报告生成耗时 90 秒（$0.17），背景验证耗时 15 秒（$0.06）。 报告在请求发出约 130 秒后出现；包含验证在内的总报告成本为 $0.70。 在此构建版本中，可执行证据使用 Python 和 pytest；其他受支持的语言也能获得决策报告。 验证功能支持每个区分性测试所触发的行为。
